title: handlers.sh does two unrelated jobs
body:
## Problem

`handlers.sh` has grown into the longest file in the repo by a wide margin, and
it holds two responsibilities that never call each other: command-line parsing
in the top half, output rendering in the bottom.

## What to do

Split it: argument parsing into `args.sh`, rendering into `render.sh`. No
behaviour change.

## Done when

- `handlers.sh` is gone, replaced by the two focused files.
- `./test.sh` still passes.

title: There is no LICENSE file
body:
The repository ships shell scripts, a test runner and a README, and nothing
saying what terms any of it is offered under. Add a LICENSE file and link it
from the README.
